business_summary.text: AWL Agri Business Limited is a diversified Food and FMCG company, with Edible Oil as its foundation and growing packaged Food, future-ready channels, and value-added businesses.

call_points.text: Edible Oil volumes grew 5% YoY while maintaining healthy profitability amidst global price volatility.
Food & FMCG revenue growth guided at 18-20% for the rest of FY27.
Edible Oil volume growth guided at 5-6% for the rest of FY27.
Food & FMCG EBITDA margin of 6% in Q1 is an average, not a new guidance target.
No specific hedging proportion disclosed; brand strength cited as the primary hedge.
Targeting ₹1 Lac+ Cr total revenue and ~₹4,000 Cr EBITDA by 2030 with >20% ROCE.
Edible oil generates steady EBITDA of ₹4,000-4,500 per MT on standalone operations.
call_points.versus_prior: in line with steady-state guidance of ₹3,500-₹3,600/MT on prior call

call_points.text: Delivered 14% volume growth reaching 1.9 million metric tons in Q4 FY26.
Steady-state operational EBITDA guided at ₹3,500 to ₹3,600 per ton across cycles.
Management targets mid-teens double-digit volume growth in Foods for FY27, prioritizing volume over margin.
Foods guided to stay EBITDA neutral through FY27, aiming for ₹1,500-₹2,000/ton EBITDA starting FY28.
Foods volume closed FY26 at 1.2 million tons; management aims to cross 1.5-1.6 million tons in FY27.
Alternate channels contribute 15% of edible oil volume and 25% of food volume, growing at 40-44%.
New installation at Krishnapatnam expected by Q4 FY27 to expand Industry Essentials volume.
Rising costs of chemicals, coal, and packing material from Iran conflict will hit industry margins in Q1 FY27.
Operational EBITDA for Q4 FY26 reached ₹628 Crore, up 40% YoY, driven by better profitability in edible oils and foods.

operating_notes.text: Direct reach crossed 9.65 lakh outlets and rural town coverage reached 63,000+ towns in Q4 FY26.
Direct reach expanded to 9.7 lakh outlets and direct plus indirect reach reached 26 lakh outlets.
Alternate channel accounts for 15% of edible oil volume and 25% of food volume.
Kohinoor volumes reached 50,000+ tons in FY26, up nearly 20% YoY.
Fortune brand achieved ₹30,000+ Cr turnover in FY26 across edible oils and foods.
Reaches 2.6 million outlets directly/indirectly and covers 63,000+ rural towns and villages.
Entered into supply, brand license, and employee transfer agreements with Shree Renuka Sugars for nationwide distribution of Madhur sugar.
Edible Oil raw material stock days: 30-35 days.
Edible Oil regional mix: 30% palm, 30-35% soya, 20% sunflower, 15% local oils (mustard, groundnuts, cotton, rice bran).
Food business B2C mix: 80%, B2B mix: 20%.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹21,464.78 Cr (+17.7% YoY), net profit ₹293.06 Cr (+53.7% YoY).
AWL Agri Business reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹21,465 Cr (+18% YoY) and net profit of ₹293 Cr (+54% YoY).
AWL Agri Business Limited shared the audio recording link for its Analysts/Investors Call on Audited Financial Results (Q4FY2025-26) held on 2026-04-29, approved by the Board on 2026-04-28.
AWL Agri Business Limited, led by Darshil Lakhia, scheduled Investor Day 2026 for institutional investors and analysts on May 21, 2026.
Q4 FY26 concall transcript: guided steady-state EBITDA of ₹3,500-3,600/t and targeted mid-teens Food volume growth in FY27.
Held Investor Day 2026 outlining Vision 2030 targets: ₹1 Lac+ Cr revenue, ~₹4,000 Cr EBITDA, and >25% Food mix.
AWL Agri Business executed definitive agreements with Shree Renuka Sugars for marketing and distribution of 'Madhur' brand sugar effective July 1, 2026.
AWL Agri Business Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings call on July 30, 2026, reporting strong revenue and profit growth.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹22,201.93 Cr (+26.1% YoY), net profit ₹239.39 Cr (-2.2% YoY).
AWL Agri Business reported Q2FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹22,202 Cr, up 26% YoY, driven by growth across Edible Oil and Food & FMCG segments.
